messages.subject: xtable errors for plot
parts:
Hello,

I keep getting this
Error in UseMethod("xtable") :
  no applicable method for 'xtable' applied to an object of class "list"

when i click on the "Nightly" tab.

Do you have an idea why?
Regards
Saptarshi




ui.R
library(shinyIncubator)
options(shiny.table.class = "offset1 data table table-bordered table-striped center-aligned table-condensed ")

introTxt <- includeHTML("intro.html")
reactiveSvg <- function (outputId)
{
  ## HTML(paste('<div id="', outputId, '" class="shiny-network-output"><svg/></div>', sep=""))
  HTML(paste("<div id=\"", outputId, "\" class=\"shiny-network-output\"><svg /></div>", sep=""))
}

mainPanel2 <- function(...){
  div(class="span11",...)
}

myLayout <- function(headerPanel,middle,mainPanel){
  bootstrapPage(
    tags$head(tags$link(href='http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto+Slab:700,300',rel='stylesheet',type='text/css')
              ,tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css",href="./local.css")
              )
    ,div(class = "container", headerPanel,middle,mainPanel)
    )
}

shinyUI(myLayout(
          headerPanel(title=HTML("Telemetry Packet Submission Graphs"))
          ,div(class="span11",introTxt)
          ,mainPanel2(
            tabsetPanel(
              ## tabPanel("Nightly",includeHTML("ab.html"),reactiveSvg(outputId = "nightlyFig"),value="nightly"),
              tabPanel("Raw Data",tableOutput("rawdata"),value="raw"),
              tabPanel("Nightly" ,plotOutput("subfigureN"),value="nightly"),
              tabPanel("Aurora"  ,plotOutput("subfigureA"),value="aurora"),
              tabPanel("Beta"    ,plotOutput("subfigureB"),value="beta"),
              tabPanel("Release" ,plotOutput("subfigureR"),value="release")
              ,id="channel"
              )
             )
          ))



server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  channelData <- reactive({
    r <- if(input$channel %in% c("nightly","aurora","beta","release")){
      Param$channel <- input$channel
      adata <- getDataForChannel(Param,A)
      (getPDAF(adata, Param))
    }else if(input$channel == "raw"){
      Param$channel <- NA
      (getDataForChannel(Param,A))
    }
    r
  })

  pt <- reactive({
    x <- channelData()
    d <- x$orig
    u <- xyplot( d$raw ~ as.Date(d$date), ylab='Submission(mm)',xlab='Date',type='p',
                panel=function(x,y,...){
                  panel.grid(v=10)
                  panel.xyplot(x,y,col='black',pc=16)
                  panel.lines(x,d$loess.fitted,lwd=2, type='l', col='blue')
                  panel.polygon(c(x,rev(x)),c(d$lbfitted,rev(d$ubfitted)),border=NA, col='#00000050')
                },scales=list(x=list(tick.num=30,cex=0.7),y=list(tick.num=10)),ylim=x$ylim
                ## ,aspect=x$aspect
                ,main=paste("Channel:",input$channel," LastSubmissionIsOutlier:", if(x$isoutlier ==1) "YES" else "NO"
                   ," corr:", round(x$corr[[1]],3)
                   ," drifting:",if(x$hasdrift>0) round(x$hasdrift,3) else "NO"
                   ,collapse=""))
    u
  })
 
  output$rawdata <- renderTable({
    x <- channelData()
    x$date = as.character(x$date)
    x$count <- as.integer(x$count)
    rownames(x) <- NULL
    x
  })

  output$subfigureN <- renderPlot({
    print(pt())
  })
 
  output$subfigureB <- renderPlot({
    print(pt())
  })

  output$subfigureR <- renderPlot({
    print(pt())
  })

  output$subfigureA <- renderPlot({
    print(pt())
  })

})

messages.subject: Re: xtable errors for plot
